title: Lantern Night Date and Venue
tests: Checks that missing event details are requested and then rendered accurately as readable text in the finished promo.

checks.name: asks first (The event date and venue to display.)

got.question: What date and venue should appear on screen?

judge.summary: The vertical promo features warm lanterns after dark with large, consistently readable event details and no voiceover.

must_haves.item: The delivered video is 8 seconds long and vertical 9:16.
must_haves.why: The supplied duration is 8 seconds, and the frames have a vertical 9:16 aspect ratio.
The exact title is clearly readable in every supplied frame.

must_haves.item: '14 November 2026' and 'Willow Park, Bristol' appear clearly on screen together for at least 3 seconds.
must_haves.why: Both lines appear together in large, high-contrast text at 1, 3, 5, and 7 seconds.

must_haves.item: Warm glowing lanterns are visible against an after-dark setting.
must_haves.why: Numerous yellow and orange illuminated lanterns appear against a dark blue sky and silhouetted trees.
The supplied audio report confirms no clear speech.
